hypothesis: The frozen V11 target path is invariant to user execution-cost settings, and its realized performance remains economically positive when fixed execution friction is stressed from 1.00% fee + 0.05% slippage to 1.50% fee + 0.10% slippage.
forbidden_changes: adding a third fee/slippage level after seeing results
claiming full G5 PASS without the separately frozen +1 session delay stress
selection_metric: No winner selection. Mechanically evaluate the preregistered component gates on adverse_cost relative to base_execution.
pass_fail_gates: adverse_cost target fingerprint == base_execution target fingerprint
all two preregistered candidate outputs are reported
even on component PASS, full G5 remains PENDING until the frozen +1 session execution-delay stress is run in the same Swift engine
follow_up_policy: Do not add or tune cost levels on this history. The only permitted follow-up for full G5 is the already-frozen +1 execution-session delay stress; it must not alter the 1.50%/0.10% adverse cost assumptions.
expected_outputs: run authorization receipt and exact Git commit
full_gate_effect: Component evidence only; full G5 status may not become PASS from this trial alone.
